intended_object: A bookkeeping map for the Mayer–Vietoris computation of the antipodal map's action on H_*(S²). It is the endomorphism of the puncture intersection S² \ {N, S} obtained by restricting the antipodal map to an ordered-cover intersection map (north∩south → south∩north) and then composing with the intersection swap. This is read off the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The definition composes two of the library's own ordered-cover maps. First, `twoOpenIntersectionMap` sends the north/south intersection to the south/north intersection using the facts that the antipodal map takes the north-punctured open into the south-punctured one and vice versa. Then `twoOpenIntersectionSwapMap` goes back to the original ordering. The very next lemma, `sphere2PunctureIntersectionAntipodalInduced_eq`, shows by `rfl` that the composite is just pointwise negation restricted to the puncture intersection, i.e. `sphere2PunctureIntersectionAntipodal`. So the definition adds nothing mathematically. It is a particular factorization of an existing map through the library's ordered-cover API, written so the Mayer–Vietoris naturality argument can track where the sign comes from. It is a proof device, not a standard object from the literature. The underlying mathematical object, the antipodal self-map of S² minus the poles, is defined separately as `sphere2PunctureIntersectionAntipodal`.
